record.question: What is the maximum letter size allowed for advertisement for an Architect in an office or construction site?
record.explanation: Verified on printed page 2 of the M.E.S. Architecture Paper-III (Mizoram PSC, March 2020); Q.20 carries options 9 cm / 9.5 cm / 10 cm / 10.5 cm with no special emphasis. The Architects (Professional Conduct) Regulations, 1989 (made by the Council of Architecture under Section 45 of the Architects Act, 1972) allow an architect to exhibit his name outside his office and on a building under construction, 'provided the lettering does not exceed 10 cm in height'. The maximum permitted letter height is therefore 10 cm, i.e. the third option.
